name: ReaperPoolJournal

test_list.description: A live journal registration is excluded from orphan recovery and can be released after cleanup.
After reopening the journal, the fake exact-label backend sees only Docker pool orphan identities and the unrelated backend record remains.
Reject orphan acknowledgement while the registration still has a live cleanup owner.
A failed exact-label cleanup does not acknowledge or remove the persisted orphan registration.
Kernel startup invokes exact-label pool recovery on the same Reaper before the generic sweep evaluates unresolved backend locators.

output_description: A Docker-owned journal implementation that durably registers cleanup and exposes only orphan Docker pool identities for exact-label recovery.
